Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent interactive medieval brewery workbench sprite for Alvorada Cinzenta dark fantasy RPG, one landscape 3:2 composition.
Primary request: richly detailed, convincing fantasy game illustration of a real medieval brewer station. Center foreground a large round open oak mash tun / wooden brewing vat, with warm amber liquid and barley mash visible inside a wide elliptical opening. The opening MUST be clearly visible from three-quarter elevated view: center at 54% image width and 43% image height, inner opening about 30% image width and 14% image height. The front wall of the vat extends down to 76% image height. To the back-left a beautifully worn copper brewing kettle with a small furnace; to the back-right a capped wooden ale barrel with brass tap. Around the base: burlap sack with barley, fresh hops, a modest wooden beer mug, folded linen. Entire workbench on an oak tray, all objects fully visible, no cropping. Dense realistic wood grain, iron hoops, aged copper, warm amber highlights, cool dark shadows, premium painted RPG inventory art. No mortar, no pestle, no glass alembic, no alchemy laboratory, no floating tool, no people, no text, no border, no watermark. Truly transparent alpha background, no scenery and no external ground shadow. No paddle in the scene; that will be a separate animated asset.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single transparent tool sprite for a medieval fantasy brewery mixing animation.
Primary request: a sturdy long oak brewer's mash paddle, one continuous shaft and one wide flat rounded slotted paddle blade, entirely made of aged dark honey-colored wood, subtly wet near the blade. Three-quarter side view, diagonal from narrow handle grip at x20% y15% to broad blade tip at x84% y87%. Clearly a brewer's wooden paddle, not a weapon, not a spoon, not a hammer. Broad blade has two or three long traditional slots for stirring grain mash. Rich realistic wood grain, worn edges, a small leather loop at the upper end. Premium hand painted realistic fantasy RPG inventory illustration, warm copper reflected light and cool dark fill. One paddle only, no hand, no other objects, no sparks, no text, no border, no watermark, truly transparent alpha background.
